newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China exchanges have market cap of 949.3 bln yuan.
newsitem.headline: China exchanges have market cap of 949.3 bln yuan.

text.p: The two Chinese stock exchanges together had a market capitalisation of 949.3 billion yuan by this month, an official at China's central bank said on Tuesday.

A total of 472 enterprises were listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges, Yin Jieyan, Deputy Governor of the People's Bank of China, told the annual World Economic Forum's Europe-East Asia summit in Hong Kong.
There were 97 securities firms, 394 trust and investment companies, and 22 investment funds in China, he added.
But he gave no comparative figures for past periods.
The expansion of the stock and bond markets followed the growth of Chinese capital markets amid the development of China's financial sector as a whole, he said.
